item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "6cec0fd809b3ab63342944f00cfa217038f967107a5e98332b13357291b3279f",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "At (x,t), there exist vectors u and v such that the time derivative of q(x,·) is u, the spatial derivative of flux(q(·,t)) is v, and u + v equals the specified production vector.",
      "effect_on_target": "For every real x, requires existing classical derivatives and their sum to equal production(x). With the supplied hypotheses and linear flux, this is qt(x) + speed qx(x) = production(x).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "At (x,t), there exist vectors u and v that are respectively the time derivative of q and spatial derivative of its flux, with u + v = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "The last conclusion denies that this zero-source equation holds at every real x at the selected time.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on Fin m → Real is jointly continuous for every natural m.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of scalar multiplication for the derivative predicates in LocalDef001; imposes no additional hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on any real-valued function space is jointly continuous in its product topology.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar-action continuity used by LocalDef002, including the singleton-indexed target space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid underlying a commutative additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and zero in constructing scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "Makes a commutative semiring an algebra over itself using the identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures speed acting on a real coordinate means ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation of an algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects ordinary real multiplication before lifting it to state vectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "All five conclusions must hold together for the same production function; derivative existence and equations within each local predicate also hold together.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring underlying a commutative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real arithmetic in the identity algebra construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed field structure and obtains nontriviality of its norm from dense norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar field structure required for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a monoid action from a distributive monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar multiplication used in the real module structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real semiring operations for modules without adding constraints.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The integral and balance equations are exact vector equalities, hence coordinatewise equalities, not almost-everywhere equalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an object satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects one production function after the universal data and hypotheses; the local predicates separately select derivative vectors at each x.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains a field's semiring, inverse, division, and associated operations as a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an intermediate real algebraic structure without changing the target's arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin n is the finite type of natural indices less than n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 1 has exactly the index 0, so every state or rate has one real coordinate; the target does not quantify over arbitrary dimensions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all indices of Fin n using finRange n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the finite index structure needed for the vector norm, integrals, and LocalDef002.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Function.hasSMul",
      "meaning": "Lifts scalar multiplication to functions through the pointwise Pi scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "The flux sends a state s to the vector with coordinate speed times s(i).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the operation of heterogeneous scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denotes scalar multiplication by speed in the flux and endpoint terms.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts the operation of heterogeneous subtraction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the ordered differences speed q(a,t) − speed q(b,t) and massRate minus that difference.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "Asserts that a function of one scalar variable has the specified derivative at a point, using the full neighborhood of that point and a fixed base point.",
      "effect_on_target": "All derivatives are ordinary two-sided real derivatives with vector values, not derivatives restricted to an interval or weak derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed scalar-space structure from an inner product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real normed-space structure used coordinatewise for differentiation and integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "Requires integrability on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the specified measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires qt, qx, and the chosen production to be integrable between the endpoints regardless of their order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "A scalar action equipped with its module topology has jointly continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of the real scalar action needed by derivative structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "The continuity properties of a topological ring give those of a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the continuity construction for ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology",
      "meaning": "A topological semiring has the module topology when acting on itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the topology of the reals to continuity of their scalar action on themselves.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished measure stored in a measure-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "All integrals and integrability statements use the distinguished measure of Real.measureSpace.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action of a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar action underlying the function-space module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the associative multiplication structure of a monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies scalar multiplication's semigroup structure without altering real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts a monoid from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real multiplicative monoid for scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semigroup action underlying a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar action used by the derivative structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the dimension parameter whose target value is the natural number 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "The defect hypothesis is a vector inequality; production ≠ 0 means the entire function is not identically zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a nonunital commutative ring's operations while forgetting its associativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an underlying real ring structure used in topological compatibility.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital nonassociative ring underlying its commutative version.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real operations in the topological-ring instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the commutative additive monoid of a nonunital nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real addition and zero for the module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the algebraic nonunital commutative ring structure while forgetting its norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topological-ring structure without changing arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital seminormed ring underlying a commutative one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real seminorm and operations used for normed vector-space structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains a nonunital seminormed ring's norm, additive group, and pseudometric as a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive norm structure on real coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonassociative structure underlying a nonunital semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and multiplication in the module instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field underlying a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real norm and field operations used for calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and metric while forgetting additive commutativity as a required field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a normed additive group on real coordinates for interval integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Builds an extended-nonnegative-valued normed additive monoid from a normed additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the extended norm used to state integrability of the vector-valued functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed commutative ring's norm, metric, and nonunital ring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topological-ring instance while retaining the same operations and topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same norm and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm in the structures used for derivatives and integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field operations and laws from a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real field operations for scalar modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed field's norm, metric, and commutative ring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a compatible real normed ring structure in the scalar topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module underlying a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real linear structure required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Not",
      "meaning": "Negation: a proposition implies False.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denies equality in both inequalities and denies the universally quantified zero-source local equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral using the chosen numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets 1 as the dimension and 0 as the zero production function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Gives a function space the coordinatewise module structure induced by its codomain.",
      "effect_on_target": "States and derivatives are real vectors with coordinatewise linear operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Gives a dependent function space the coordinatewise commutative additive group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Derivative vectors can be added and subtracted coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Pi.instSub",
      "meaning": "Function subtraction is defined by (f − g)(i) = f(i) − g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Endpoint flux differences and integral defects are coordinatewise differences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero function takes the zero value at every argument.",
      "effect_on_target": "The zero compared with production is zero for every real x and every coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Equips a finite product of normed additive commutative groups with its product normed additive commutative group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the vector norm and metric required for the interval integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Equips a finite product of normed additive groups with its product normed additive group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the norm used by interval integrability of singleton-coordinate vectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Pi.normedSpace",
      "meaning": "A finite product of normed scalar spaces is a normed scalar space with coordinatewise module operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the state space a real normed space suitable for vector integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The function-space topology is the product topology induced by all coordinate evaluation maps.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector derivative limits use the product real topology, which here has just one coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure of a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real distance to the topology used in derivative limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Gives an RCLike field its real inner product structure and underlying real normed-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specialized to Real, supplies the real scalar-space structure of each coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real-number type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Space, time, endpoints, speed, and all vector coordinates are real-valued.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field has densely available positive norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a nontrivially normed real scalar field for HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The addition operation on real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real addition used in scalar topology and vector arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The commutative additive group structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports coordinatewise additive groups for the state and derivative vectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The commutative semiring structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the identity algebra making real scalar multiplication ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "Real has an RCLike structure with real part the identity, imaginary part zero, distinguished I equal to zero, and its real field, order, norm, and completeness structures.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real inner product and normed-space instances; introduces no complex-valued coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure on real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real additive and multiplicative operations for the module instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction is addition of the additive negative.",
      "effect_on_target": "Gives the ordinary subtraction signs in flux and mass-rate differences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the zero coordinate, zero vector, and identically zero production function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "Selects the installed measure-space structure on Real; its displayed body is inferInstance and does not expose the selected measure or its normalization.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the measure used throughout. The exact translation can retain μ = Real.measureSpace.volume; identifying μ explicitly as normalized Lebesgue measure is not justified by this displayed body alone.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Combines the real norm, additive commutative group, and metric into a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the coordinate norm and metric for the vector-valued integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Combines the real normed additive group and real commutative ring with the norm-multiplication bound.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures real arithmetic and topology are compatible in all normed structures used.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "Combines the real field with its norm and metric, including multiplicativity of the norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the normed scalar field for differentiation and vector integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real distance is d(x,y) = |x − y|, with the associated uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Derivative limits and scalar continuity use the ordinary real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real self-module topology and scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring underlying a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real operations when building the function-space module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains a semifield's division-semiring structure and operations while dropping commutativity as a required field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an intermediate real structure for scalar modules without changing arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the real scalar operation used in continuity instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a seminormed commutative ring's norm, pseudometric, and nonunital operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real additive seminorm structure used for the coordinate normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed ring underlying a commutative one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real seminormed ring used to recover its scalar topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric structure from a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar topology through the uniform-space construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains a semiring's multiplication, identity, powers, and absorbing zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar multiplicative monoid underlying real actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital semiring underlying a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real operations on the route to the additive monoid used by modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the usual real topology and the coordinate topologies for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 as the zero of the chosen type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the target's production ≠ 0 a comparison against the zero function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "instContinuousSMulForall",
      "meaning": "Coordinatewise jointly continuous scalar actions induce a jointly continuous scalar action on the product function space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuous real scalar multiplication on the state space for HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary scalar multiplication operation as heterogeneous scalar multiplication with the same result type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed hSMul applications are the existing real-on-vector action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D088",
      "name": "instHSub",
